Quick asks:
- Can you confirm the primary technical attendees (names + emails) so we can tailor the demo?
- Any hard constraints on timing next week (May 24–28) or particular windows that are blocked?
- Procurement asked for SOC 2 summary and a short security questionnaire in advance — I copied procurement above.

Proposed windows (PT):
1) Tue May 25 — 10:00–11:00
2) Wed May 26 — 14:00–15:00
3) Thu May 27 — 08:00–09:00 (earlier slot)

I attached a short demo deck and our SE checklist to show scope and typical agenda. If those slots don't work, share 2–3 preferred times and we'll reconcile.

Vanessa / Alice — happy to run this. Suggested agenda (60m):
- 5m quick intros & goals
- 20m architecture & integration patterns (how Redwood routes and pins models, VPC options)
- 20m live demo: sample inference flow, latency/cost tradeoffs, caching behavior
- 10m security/procurement Q&A + next steps

I can cover the VPC/private deployment and bounded-resource patterns if your infra team wants those details. For timing, Tue May 25 at 10:00 PT works for me. If you need a later UTC-friendly slot I can do Wed May 26 at 14:00 PT as backup.

Also — what level of access do your engineers want during demo? Live access to test data or a synthetic workspace? We usually keep customer data off demos unless there's an NDA / sandbox provision.

— Markus Klein
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
